buffer.note: trajectory advection buffer (osse.tex sec:glorys): floats advect in/out

boxes_halo.note: boxes A (22-34N) + B (35-45N), 40-60W, plus ~2 deg halo; truth OHC + mu

period.note: daily thetao extended back to 2010: the residual field Z_k defines the ANALYSIS years, and m=5 of them is what makes the matched indicator collinear with lag 0 in the placebo matrix. m=10 makes lags 1-9 estimable. Monte-Carlo replication cannot substitute -- the diagonal carries one flow-year draw per k whatever D is.

depth_bands.note: surf = top ~3 levels (0.49/1.54/2.6 m); park brackets 1000 m (902.3/1062.4 m)

thetao_depth_note: 0-2000 m OHC; upper bound includes level ~2225 m straddling 2000 m for partial weighting

groups.name: static
groups.note: split dataset: bathy (deptho/deptho_lev/mask) + coords (e1t/e2t/e3t); e3t is cell thickness for the OHC integral

groups.name: static
groups.note: deptho over the full advection domain (the boxes_halo pull above covers only the thetao region); same out_dir, distinct file_prefix

groups.name: thetao_daily
groups.note: OHC field: thetao only, no salinity. salinity_test (logs/osse_salinity_test.txt) found in-situ TEOS-10 vs constant rho*cp differ by mean +0.06% (max 0.46%) over Box B, so constant CP*RHO*potential-temperature (code/ohc.py) is used

groups.name: velocity_daily
groups.note: velocity spans MORE years than the analysis window, for two reasons. (1) Unaligned (l != k) cells are the no-coupling counterfactual and set the null scale for the diagonal. (2) The steady arm spins up over the PRECEDING 540 d, so the earliest analysis year is bounded by the velocity start: 2008 keeps analysis years from 2010. Note extra velocity years buy little precision on a per-year contrast -- var = sigma_f^2 (1 + 1/M) and the 1 is the diagonal's own flow-year draw -- so 2008 is chosen to cover the spin-up, not to grow M. Same buffer region and depth bands throughout so the extra years are exchangeable with the rest.

groups.name: zos_daily
groups.note: pinned to the original window: this feeds the eddy census, not the sampling-bias analysis, so it is deliberately NOT extended with the global period

region.note: Box B (Gulf Stream extension), the more energetic box
